title: Warm Silky Moroccan Lamb Sellou
description: A comforting Moroccan dish featuring lamb, milk, and lardons, served in a traditional sellou form on a slate tile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the pot and set aside, leaving the rendered fat behind.
Add the olive oil to the pot and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the milk, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lardons to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the sellou hot, garnished with fresh herbs and crusty bread on the side.
